ayahs.1: Haanpte hue daudne wale ghodon ki qasam!
ayahs.2: Phir taap maar kar aag jhaadne walon ki qasam!
ayahs.3: Phir subah ke waqt dhaawa bolne walon ki qasam.
ayahs.4: Pas is waqt gard-o-ghubaar udaate hain.
ayahs.5: Phir isi ke saath faujiyon ke darmiyan ghus jaate hain.
ayahs.6: Yaqeenan insaan apne Rabb ka bada na-shukra hai.
ayahs.7: Aur yaqeenan woh khud bhi is par gawaah hai.
ayahs.8: Yeh maal ki mohabbat mein bhi bada sakht hai.
ayahs.9: Kya use woh waqt maloom nahin jab qabron mein jo (kuchh) hai nikaal liya jaayega.
ayahs.10: Aur seenon ki posheeda baaten zaahir kar di jaaengi.
ayahs.11: Beshak un ka Rabb us din un ke haal se poora ba-khabar hoga.
